waypoints.name: Ross Dam Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Marblemount, drive SR-20 east into North Cascades National Park to the Ross Dam Trailhead parking area near milepost 134. A backcountry permit is required for any overnight stay, including the camp in the Big Beaver valley.

waypoints.name: Mount Prophet summit
waypoints.directions: Descend the Ross Dam Trail about 0.8 mile, cross Ross Dam and follow the Big Beaver Trail north along Ross Lake (or take the water taxi to Big Beaver Landing), then up the Big Beaver valley to Luna Camp. Climb the forested rib, traverse southeast past the short Class 4 ledge near 5,450 ft, bypass the 6,900 ft cliff band by the snow ramp on its right, and follow the crest from the 7,420 ft saddle, passing a gendarme on its south side.
